abilities.name: Dough-Fu
abilities.note:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Guoba Attack
abilities.note: Summons Guoba, who will continuously breathe fire at opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

abilities.name: Pyronado
abilities.note:
Displaying her mastery over both fire and polearms, Xiangling sends a Pyronado whirling around her.
The Pyronado will move with your character for the ability's duration, dealing Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path.

passives.name: Crossfire
passives.note: Increases the flame range of Guoba by 20%.

passives.name: Beware, It's Super Hot!
passives.note: When Guoba Attack's effect ends, Guoba leaves a chili pepper on the spot where it disappeared. Picking up a chili pepper increases ATK by 10% for 10s.

passives.name: Chef de Cuisine
passives.note: When Xiangling cooks an ATK-boosting dish perfectly, she has a 12% chance to receive double the product.

constellations.name: Crispy Outside, Tender Inside
constellations.note: Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their Pyro RES reduced by 15% for 6s.

constellations.name: Oil Meets Fire
constellations.note: The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

constellations.name: Deepfry
constellations.note:
Increases the Level of Pyronado by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Guoba Mad
constellations.note:
Increases the Level of Guoba Attack by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Condensed Pyronado
constellations.note: For the duration of Pyronado, all party members receive a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus.
